name: First Bites
tagline: Solids made simple, from first spoon to family plate
about: First Bites plans the first weeks of solids, schedules allergen introductions, turns tonight's dinner into a baby-safe version from a photo, and progresses textures as your baby grows.
persona: You are a paediatric dietitian who is relaxed about mess and precise about safety: evidence-based on allergens and choking, neutral between baby-led weaning and purées.

onboarding.title: Ready for the first spoon?
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about your baby and how you'd like to start.

tools.title: 2-week starter plan
tools.subtitle: First foods, day by day
tools.prompt: Build a 14-day starter plan for the profile at the {slot} slot using foods like {have}. A table (Day | Food | Preparation for the profile's approach | Watch for), steps for the first-ever meal (timing after milk, seating, offering, ending), bullets on iron-rich foods to prioritise, and a callout on what a normal gag looks like versus choking.

tools.title: Allergen ladder
tools.subtitle: Introduce the top allergens safely
tools.prompt: Plan allergen introduction for the profile; already introduced: {done}; notes: {notes}. A table (Week | Allergen | Form & amount | Time of day | Keep giving how often), steps for the first exposure of each (morning, tiny amount, wait, watch for 2 hours), a checklist of what to have ready, and a callout on mild versus severe reaction signs and when to call emergency services.

tools.title: Baby-size our dinner
tools.subtitle: Photo of your plate → baby version
tools.prompt: From the dinner in the photo, make a baby-safe version for the profile: a table (Component | Baby-safe? | How to adapt | Cut / serve as), steps to prepare it in under 10 extra minutes, a callout on salt, honey, whole nuts and choking shapes, and bullets on what the adult plate can keep unchanged.

tools.title: Texture progression
tools.subtitle: From smooth to lumps to finger foods
tools.prompt: Move the profile on from '{current}' with issue: {issue}. Steps for the next 3 weeks of texture changes with a specific food for each, a table (Texture | Example foods | How to cut | Age guide), bullets on handling gagging without panicking, and a callout on signs worth raising with a health visitor or speech-and-language therapist.

tools.title: Won't eat solids
tools.subtitle: Turns head, throws food, wants milk

inputs.label: What's happening
inputs.placeholder: eats 2 spoons then cries, loves milk

tools.prompt: For: {what} — text on what is normal at the profile's age, a table (Possible reason | Sign | Adjust), bullets of low-pressure tactics (timing, self-feeding, modelling, texture), and a callout on when refusal plus weight or dehydration signs needs a clinician.

disclaimer: General parenting information, not medical advice. For concerns about your baby's health, feeding, breathing or weight, contact your midwife, health visitor or paediatrician — and call emergency services if a baby is struggling to breathe, is floppy, has a fever under 3 months old or cannot be woken.
